name: HOI4D
tagline: 2.4M RGB-D ego frames, 4,000+ sequences: 4 people handle 800 objects (16 categories) in 610 rooms; hand pose, object pose, panoptic labels.

annotations.format: JSON (actions, object pose) + PNG masks + PCD (3D) + pickle (MANO hands)
annotations.coverageNote: Per-frame action labels, 2D motion masks, MANO hand pose and category-level object pose on all released sequences; part of the data is held out as a test set.

action_labels.note: Per-frame action segments (event, startTime, endTime) in action/color.json

segmentation.note: 2D motion masks (hands + interacting objects); 3D static and 4D dynamic panoptic seg

hand_pose.note: MANO per frame (poseCoeff 48, beta 10, trans) + 21 projected 2D keypoints

object_pose.note: Category-level part poses (center, rotation, dimensions) + CAD meshes, articulated parts

camera_pose.note: Per-frame camera trajectory (output.log, Open3D pinhole trajectory)

scene_3d.note: Reconstructed static scene point cloud per sequence (raw_pc.pcd + label.pcd)

annotations.sample:
# <seq>/handpose/<frame>.pickle  (MANO, right hand)
  poseCoeff : 48 floats   # 3 global rotation + 45 MANO pose params
  beta      : 10 floats   # MANO shape (same for each human ID H*)
  trans     : [x, y, z]   # hand translation in camera frame
  kps2D     : 21 x 2      # projected keypoints on the image

# <seq>/objpose/<frame>.json  ->  dataList[i]
  center     : {x, y, z}
  rotation   : {x, y, z}            # Euler XYZ
  dimensions : {length, width, height}

samples.caption: Hand action segments, motion segmentation, 3D hand + category-level object pose, panoptic seg, object mesh
